question: The 8th edition of India-Kazakhstan Joint Military Exercise KAZIND-2024 was held in ________.
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Auli, Uttarakhand**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The 8th edition of the **India-Kazakhstan Joint Military Exercise** KAZIND-2024 was held in **Auli, Uttarakhand**.
 
• This exercise aims to **enhance military cooperation** between the two countries.
 
• **Auli** is known for its beautiful **ski resorts** and stunning **landscapes**.
 
• Located in the **Chamoli district** of Uttarakhand, Auli is a popular destination for **skiing and winter sports**.
 
• The joint military exercise focuses on **counter-terrorism operations** and **mountain warfare training**.
 
• Such exercises are crucial for **strengthening bilateral relations** and improving the operational capabilities of the armed forces of both nations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Shillong, Meghalaya**__

 __
 
• **Shillong** is the capital of **Meghalaya** and is known for its scenic beauty and vibrant culture.
 
• It is often referred to as the **"Scotland of the East"** due to its rolling hills and pleasant climate.
 
 
 
• **Pune, Maharashtra**__
 __
 
• **Pune** is a major city in **Maharashtra**, known for its educational institutions and IT industry.
 
• It is also a significant cultural hub with a rich history.
 
 
 
• **Jaisalmer, Rajasthan**__
 
 
• **Jaisalmer**, also known as the **"Golden City"**, is located in the heart of the **Thar Desert** in Rajasthan.
 
• It is famous for its **sand dunes, forts, and palaces**.
